text: Up you come, then, ~slowly~, there you are. Lean on me as much as you like, I've carried cordwood heavier than you up that hill and it never once thanked me.

what: Hew, on the card that asks you to walk
text: Have a little walk about first, stray, get the blood back in your legs, and mind the carts, they're still _burning_.

what: Narration: coming round after the Stoker knocks you down
text: You come round on the rise with a mouthful of ash, and it's still down there by the cordwood, _waiting_ for you.

what: Narration: cutting the javelin out of the Stoker
text: There's something hard under its breastbone, grown in like a knot in oak, and it takes Hew's poker and most of what you've got left to lever it out. It's a javelin, haft and all, longer than the wound it came out of, and ~warm~.

what: Narration: leaving the wood for Wickhold
text: The wood thins and then gives out, and there's a road, and at the end of it walls, with a ~glow~ over them that isn't the moon. Your left foot is wet through at the heel, just as Hew said it would be.
